sources.title: National Groundwater Quality 2023 Report
sources.provenance_note: Verified: Tiruppur district stations were omitted from the 2023 national quality publication (only Vellitirupur in neighbouring Erode appears). Hence, multi-year cross-season repeated quality comparisons cannot be claimed without inventing data.

sources.title: Daily Corrected Precipitation (PRECTOTCORR)
sources.provenance_note: Modelled satellite-assimilated point estimate; provides meteorological context, not an official district-wide rain gauge network average.

sources.title: Relative Oceanic Niño Index (RONI)
sources.measurement_unit: °C sea surface temperature anomaly relative to tropical mean
sources.provenance_note: Global Pacific oceanic-atmospheric ENSO context. Serves as climate backdrop, not direct proof of local water level causality.

sources.title: Budget 2022-23 (containing static ward/zone illustration)
sources.provenance_note: Static cartographic visual only. Lacks vector boundaries / GeoJSON polygon geometries. As required by evidence rules, well points are not artificially attributed to municipal wards without authoritative spatial boundaries.

key_findings.deepest_well_recorded: Pallapalayam Pz (Udumalaipettai) at 84.7 m bgl, followed by Dharapuram Ponnapuram Pz (>50 m bgl) and Sangarandampalayam Pz (20.85 m bgl)
key_findings.highest_salinity_recorded: Arugampalayam (Uthukuli) with EC 4,290 µS/cm and TDS 2,789 mg/L (well above BIS permissible limit of 2,000 mg/L)
key_findings.seasonal_quality_dynamics: Nachipalayam TDS increased from 1,398 mg/L (Pre-monsoon) to 1,709 mg/L (Post-monsoon) and EC from 2,150 to 2,860 µS/cm, showing post-monsoon ionic concentration/leaching
key_findings.climate_context: 2023 rainfall totalled 582.4 mm (subdued SWM and NEM during strong El Niño onset) while 2024 totalled 812.6 mm as ENSO decayed toward neutral/La Niña conditions
